answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a hardware enclave key whose lattice signature must pass a rate-limited, side-channel-hardened attestation before any consensus vote. Even under a gale of forged registrations, the protocol caps per-enclave weight so a colluding terrace of clones cannot outvote honest lotus holders across epochs. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
